frontier_definition: Maximum Epoch ECI among publicly available models (API, hosted or open-weights access per Epoch's accessibility label) of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI, on Epoch's current ECI fit. Other organizations' models are outside this roster.

coordinates.rationale: OpenAI models as attributed by Epoch's Organization field.
limitations: Epoch release dates stand in for public availability.
Scores are on Epoch's current retrospective fit, not the scores published at each release.

pace_rationale: Default pace shape 5, a conservative round judgment informed by the rolling-origin pinball backtest of these releases (shape 8 scored best overall, 5 at three months), and default pace cap 4, a judgment that no lab progresses faster than four times the pooled trend rate, about twice the fastest twelve months of any roster lab in these releases; see methodology.md and assumptions.md (OBS-PUBLIC-JOINT).
pooling_rationale: One trend rate for the five labs is the simplest model the roughly 44 window records support; separate per-lab fits overstate frontier growth.
likelihood_rationale: Each frontier-raising release in the 24-month window enters once; benchmark error is half the 90% bootstrap interval width over 1.645 and the shared discrepancy is estimated by pooled restricted maximum likelihood.
limitations: Retrospective current-vintage ECI scores dated at each model's release date; no point-in-time score vintages.

Release dates are Epoch's records. Checked on 2026-11-25 against the developers' own release pages, 38 of the 44 trend-window records match to the day, five differ by 1 to 21 days and one has no dated developer page.
